page.notes: Doubtful readings: "Musæi" (the word after "manuscriptum" looks like Mufxi, possibly a long-s form; [?] applied). "Plurimii" and "deinque" (rendered "deniqve" in print; I normalised the vowel u) and "oprandum" (the letters look like "oprandum", possibly "optandum") are uncertain. "fa-cimus" is split at the line end with a damaged "c" at the start of the next line. The catchword "speci" is printed at the bottom right. The reading of "fpcci" is taken as the long s "speci". The paragraph has no indent, so it is one continuing paragraph from the previous page.
